claim: Logs weight, reps, and RIR for each set.
sandbox: Fresh /demo; log a 42.5 kg set with 9 reps and 3 RIR, then observe the next-set progress.

claim: Applies the all-sets-top or total-rep rule with an optional RIR floor.
sandbox: Fresh /demo; observe a below-top repeat, then configure a 30-rep total and observe an increase.

claim: Keeps a logged set in this browser after reload.
sandbox: Fresh /demo; log a set, reload, and observe the persisted next-set position.

claim: Shows whether to repeat or increase and gives the next weight.
sandbox: Fresh /demo; complete an all-top session and a below-top session, then observe both outcomes.

claim: Exports the complete log as CSV.
sandbox: Fresh /demo; download CSV and verify its header and all 18 sample set rows.

claim: Rejects invalid CSV before changing the log.
sandbox: Fresh /demo; import an invalid row and verify the row error and unchanged six-session log.

claim: Provides an installable PWA shell that caches the demo route.
sandbox: Fresh /demo; verify the live manifest, active service worker, and cached demo route.

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Own fresh browser context; load /demo, wait for service worker, switch offline, then reload the populated demo.

claim: Demo data is isolated from the real log, and no training data leaves the browser.
where: Demo banner, landing facts, privacy page, README
sandbox: Create one real session, use and reset /demo, assert separate IndexedDB counts and only same-origin requests.

claim: The free core stays available; Compass Plus costs $12 once and reveals all past sessions on a verified device.
sandbox: Fresh /demo; observe five free rows and the $12 offer, mock a valid verification, then observe six rows.

claim: A returned license token is stored locally and verified at most once per day.
sandbox: Fresh /demo with a returned token and recorded valid billing response; reload and observe one verification request.
